specific_diseases_listed: Surgery on internal or external tumours/cysts/nodules/polyps/breast lumps
All types of Hernia and Hydrocele
Vertebro-spinal disorders (including disc) and knee conditions
Surgery of varicose veins and varicose ulcers
sub_limits_waiting_notes: 12 months for specified surgical conditions; 90 days for Hypertension/Heart Disease/Diabetes; 30 days initial; 36 months PED.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Eligible hospitalization expenses over and above the deductible - up to SI
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room rent, ICU, OT, doctor fees, medicines, diagnostics, prosthetics/implants part of operation, physiotherapy as inpatient.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Day care procedures up to Sum Insured
day_care_treatments.notes: Less than 24 hours hospitalization due to technological advancement.

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Reasonable and customary charges including pre/post hospitalization

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Government hospital or institute recognized by government / accredited by QCI / NABH

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Reasonable and customary charges towards maternity expenses during hospitalisation

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Organ donor's treatment for harvesting, including pre/post hospitalization
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Per Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Actual ambulance expenses or Rs.5,000 whichever lower per valid hospitalization claim

copayment_trigger_notes: Deductible (aggregate) applies to all claims; top-up plan structure - kicks in after deductible threshold breached.
permanent_exclusions: External medical equipment for home use (CPAP, CAPD, oxygen concentrator)
Mental healthcare (limited per Mental Health Care Act 2017)
notable_exclusions_summary: Arogya Top-Up is an aggregate-deductible top-up policy. Excludes external congenital anomalies, refractive error, infertility, war/nuclear injuries, treatment outside India, and home-use medical equipment. Covers HIV/AIDS, Mental Illness, Genetic Disorders (Rs.1L), Internal Congenital Diseases (10% SI), and 12 advance procedures.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospitals; reimbursement claims processed after deductible threshold met. Helpline 91 22 42412000.
